digest.component_or_area: bridge gate format and pause/resume surface
propositions: Pause blocks before pass-lock acquisition or ticket mutation and returns rc 0 with exact anchored JSON-decoded BRIDGE_PAUSED marker; workflow recognizes only complete rc-0 marker and skips commit-and-push

Remote refs/reconciler/gate blob remains dual-format with gated_mode: reconcile-check plus paused/reason/who/paused_at; pause provenance uses repository git user.email and first-pause UTC RFC3339 time
Same-reason pause is idempotent and preserves metadata; different reason, blank reason, missing identity, missing remote, and CAS movement refuse without overwrite
Resume deletes only observed ref OID and recovers corrupt blob without decoding; corrupt state emits exact rc-1 recovery line without traceback
Old reconcile-check early return, legacy gate rc 4, and rebar reconcile --mode vocabulary remain functional; malformed/unanchored markers retain existing behavior
